T: Keep the change. Pass the pizza.
D: An eight-year-old left behind at Christmas defends his house from two burglars.
P: Serve the pizza when the delivery guy turns up at the door.
S: a whole cheese pizza, all to himself
Pizza dough rolled thin, topped with a quick tomato sauce and plenty of mozzarella, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 6 minutes, cut into small squares.
the giant sundae he builds watching a gangster film

Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with homemade hot fudge, salted caramel, whipped cream, crushed nuts, marshmallows, sprinkles and cherries to build your own. Heat 150ml cream with 150g chopped dark chocolate and 2 tbsp golden syrup, stirring until glossy. Melt 100g brown sugar with 50g butter, add 100ml cream and a pinch of salt and simmer 2 minutes. Whip 300ml thickened cream. Set out 1L vanilla and 1L chocolate ice cream with the sauces, cream and bowls of 80g crushed peanuts, 100g mini marshmallows, sprinkles and cocktail cherries.
the paint cans swinging down the stairs
Popcorn tossed in melted butter and salt, half of it coated in red-tinted white chocolate, mixed together in clean paint tins.
M: the TV dinner he heats up all by himself
Macaroni boiled 2 minutes short, folded through a sauce of butter, flour, milk, sharp cheddar and a little mustard, topped with breadcrumbs and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
the family Christmas Kevin has the house to himself for

Leg ham scored in diamonds, studded with cloves and glazed with brown sugar, orange and mustard, with crispy roast potatoes and honey carrots. Remove the skin from a 3kg half leg ham, score the fat into diamonds and stud with cloves. Simmer 150g brown sugar, the juice of 2 oranges and 2 tbsp Dijon for 5 minutes. Bake the ham at 180C for 45 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil at 220C for 45 minutes and 500g carrots with honey for 30 minutes.
W: the cookies left out for the house
Butter sugar cookies cut into stars and trees, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white and green with silver cachous.
K: keep the change with this one

Cold milk blended thick with chocolate ice cream, malt powder and chocolate syrup, topped with whipped cream and a cherry. Blend 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp chocolate syrup for 30 seconds until thick. Drizzle a little more chocolate syrup inside 4 tall glasses, pour in the shake and top with 150ml whipped cream and a cocktail cherry.

s.note: a whole cheese pizza, all to himself
s.how: Simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes with a garlic clove and oregano for 10 minutes. Stretch 500g pizza dough thin, spread with sauce and cover with 250g mozzarella. Bake on a hot tray at the oven's highest heat for 6 minutes and cut into small squares.

s.note: the paint cans swinging down the stairs
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss half with 30g melted butter and salt. Melt 150g white chocolate with red colouring and toss through the other half, then let it set. Mix both together and serve in clean paint tins.

m.note: the TV dinner he heats up all by himself
m.how: Cook 400g macaroni 2 minutes short. Melt 50g butter, stir in 3 tbsp flour, whisk in 750ml milk until thick, then add 250g grated cheddar and 1 tsp mustard. Fold through, top with 50g breadcrumbs and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

w.note: the cookies left out for the house
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll out, cut into stars and trees and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar, some tinted green, and add silver cachous.

d.note: keep the change with this one
d.how: Blend 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops chocolate ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp chocolate syrup for 30 seconds until thick. Drizzle a little more chocolate syrup inside 4 tall glasses, pour in the shake and top with 150ml whipped cream and a cocktail cherry.
